title: Alignment Whack-a-Mole : Finetuning Activates Verbatim Recall of Copyrighted Books in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.20957v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Frontier LLM companies have repeatedly assured courts and regulators that their models do not store copies of training data. They further rely on safety alignment strategies via RLHF, system prompts, and output filters to block verbatim regurgitation of copyrighted works, and have cited the efficacy of these measures in their legal defenses against copyright infringement claims. We show that finetuning bypasses these protections: by training models to expand plot summaries into full text, a task naturally suited for commercial writing assistants, we cause GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.1 to reproduce up to 85-90% of held-out copyrighted books, with single verbatim spans exceeding 460 words, using only semantic descriptions as prompts and no actual book text. This extraction generalizes across authors: finetuning exclusively on Haruki Murakami's novels unlocks verbatim recall of copyrighted books from over 30 unrelated

translated_title: 对齐“打地鼠”：微调激活大语言模型对受版权保护书籍的逐字复现能力
translated_abstract: 前沿大语言模型公司多次向法院和监管机构保证，其模型不会存储训练数据的副本。他们还依赖通过RLHF、系统提示词和输出过滤器实现的安全对齐策略来阻止受版权保护作品的逐字复现，并在针对版权侵权指控的法律辩护中引用了这些措施的有效性。我们证明，微调可以绕过这些保护措施：通过训练模型将情节摘要扩展为全文（这是一项天然适合商业写作助手的任务），我们使GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.1在仅使用语义描述作为提示、不含任何实际书籍文本的情况下，就能复现多达85-90%的保留版权书籍，单个逐字片段超过460个单词。这种提取方法可跨作者泛化：仅使用村上春树的小说进行微调，就能解锁对来自30多个不相关……（此处摘要被截断）
tldr: 研究发现微调可以绕过大语言模型的安全对齐防护——通过训练模型将情节摘要扩展为全文，仅用语义描述作为提示就能使GPT-4o等前沿模型逐字复现多达85-90%的受版权保护书籍内容。
en_tdlr: Fine-tuning bypasses LLM safety alignment: by training models to expand plot summaries into full text using only semantic descriptions, GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.1 can verbatim reproduce up to 85-90% of copyrighted books.
